status: Selected authored pilot implemented for finite lazy NumPy generation and exact observable centroid search; no trained model, finance accuracy or GPU-throughput validation
scope: bounded-context ICL over finite large finance histories
precedence: This JSON incorporates root final decisions: full verified-negative index primary; 70/20/10 training search coverage; farthest-first P then R centers; prototypes only from selected P; global query proposal before routing; complete-reference-only prevalence metadata.

joint_profile.pure_standard_control: Unchanged research/specs/static_recipe_v3.json, including its original head probabilities; joint-standard head allocation is deliberately different.
joint_profile.profile_draw_unit: macroepisode; one ordinary episode is one standard macroepisode

conventions.rng: counter-based independent streams keyed by world_id, namespace, finite_row_id, mechanism/component, and draw index; never mutable request order
conventions.missing_type: explicit missingness flag, not a nominal category silently conflated with observed data
conventions.stable_ids: persisted random IDs independent of values and labels, retained across regeneration, deduplication and permutation tests
conventions.precision: float64 reference generation/count calibration; counts integer; actual model precision follows architecture specification
conventions.integer_day_clock: historical days -90..-1, future days 1..30, snapshot cutoff0; feature and label availability comparisons use <= cutoff
conventions.world_retry: never retry a valid world to obtain positives, classes, campaigns or hard negatives; report numerical failures explicitly

population_names.N_world_history: all historical records, including unknown/unreported outcomes; maximum3000000
population_names.N_world_future: all records in the independently generated finite future population
population_names.N_eligible: historical rows whose selected task target is actually revealed by cutoff under the declared eligibility policy
population_names.M_eligible: verified eventful rows within N_eligible; fraud or positive fraud loss for event tasks; not latent fraud count
population_names.N_reference: rows of a representative complete adjudicated cohort used for reference frequency; may be a strict subset of eligible history
population_names.M_reference: known eventful records among those same N_reference rows
population_names.G_count: actual eligible negative candidates searched, not original total history size
population_names.not_equal: N_world_history-M_eligible is NOT a verified-negative count

finite_world.calibration_visibility: independent generator calibration only; not context or scored query rows

arrival_volume.interval: draw start RU(0,120-duration) on ordered historical+future day positions; multiply duration consecutive positions by selected multiplier
arrival_volume.daily_counts: normalize weights separately within historical90/future30 days and draw multinomial totals N_world_history and N_world_future

prevalence.campaign_center: uniform among the120 declared integer days
prevalence.intercept: 64 bisection iterations alpha in[-50,20] to match sum_history(N_d*sigmoid(alpha+log(g_d)))/N_world_history=pi
prevalence.daily_risk: p_d=sigmoid(alpha+log(g_d)); future uses same law unless separately flagged drift ablation
prevalence.future_drift_rule: add log(kappa) to future logits only; this is conditional distribution drift, not merely arrival volume
prevalence.learner_visibility: true pi, alpha, daily probabilities and latent future fractions are excluded from model inputs
prevalence.operational_target_description: User-corrected central operating point: one fraud per10000 events; middle interval carries70% of finance worlds.
prevalence.subtarget_rarity: Rates below1e-5 are excluded from the default recipe. Explicit zero-evidence/subtarget boundary tests are not the operational target.

class_counts.daily_fraud: M_d~Binomial(N_d,p_d), independently conditional on frozen world and day counts
class_counts.zero_counts: retain, including no historical fraud, no revealed fraud, and no future fraud
class_counts.campaign_count_interpretation: daily rates and campaign-shared features induce clustered evidence; model does not additionally claim beta-binomial total-count overdispersion

lazy_materialization.finite_ids: each stratum stores its exact integer count and a stable finite ID range
lazy_materialization.uniform_sample: multivariate hypergeometric allocation across strata, then uniform IDs within selected strata without replacement
lazy_materialization.row_regeneration: keyed row stream gives identical latent values, rendered features and labels on repeated access
lazy_materialization.index: generate observable codec/index features for declared searched IDs; never substitute latent-distance selection
lazy_materialization.stored_full_rows: bounded selected support rows; retain only needed index/centers/top-k data during scans
lazy_materialization.all_history_branch: must execute full declared eligible candidate search; do not silently cap it or call sampled order statistics full-history neighbors

regression.amount: exp(2+0.4*v_1+0.2*v_2+epsilon), epsilon~N(0,1); independently multiply by Pareto(shape3,min1) with probability0.05
regression.full_amount_inputs: exclude amount itself from predictor features; reserve its would-be column for an independent distractor
regression.fraud_loss_inputs: amount may occupy one ordinary observable feature because it is available at the decision; never include fraud_loss itself
regression.fraud_loss_target_availability: fraud verification/maturity process; unresolved fraud status means unresolved fraud-loss target
regression.density_note: realized_fraud_loss uses an exact zero atom plus existing continuous density for positive log1p(loss); full_amount retains continuous regression
regression.zero_atom_probability_head: bias-free 1024-to-1 scalar head, +1024 parameters; zero-atom logit offset -logit(pi_reference) when a complete reference is available
regression.hurdle_flag: true for realized_fraud_loss; false for full_amount

feature_world.hard_negative: when H=1 draw matching fraud mode with same mode_weights and positive coordinates except discriminator5
feature_world.hard_negative_discriminator: N(-Delta,1) with probability1-xi; N(Delta,1) with probabilityxi
feature_world.mixing: one random orthogonal8x8 map shared by all rows; obtain QR of iid Gaussian matrix with deterministic diagonal-sign convention
feature_world.campaign_feature_offset: N(0,0.5^2*I_8), fixed per campaign; same campaign law for positive and matching hard-negative motifs
feature_world.campaign_assignment: given day draw background/campaign in proportion to1 and each campaign risk-kernel contribution
feature_world.remaining_features: existing static-v3 copy/distractor factory on nonreserved columns
feature_world.rendering: existing static-v3 numeric/category rendering, with finance missingness overriding its MCAR module
feature_world.rare_hard_negative_scarcity: do not retry when searched candidate pool misses rare negative component
feature_world.finite_world_feature_distribution: feature offsets and shared parameters persist across source rows and all4 reused macroepisodes

missingness.block_partition: random permutation of nonreserved ordinary feature indices, round-robin into4 fixed blocks; reservedH/channel/entity/day remain observable
missingness.MCAR: world rate LU(0.01,0.20), independent cell masks on ordinary features
missingness.channel_block: draw fixed4x4 Bernoulli(0.8) availability matrix; per row/block missing probability0.02 ifavailable else0.95; one shared block-mask draw
missingness.value_dependent: one latent coordinate per block chosenuniformly; logistic(b+0.75*v_j+0.8*1[channel==0]); one shared block-mask draw
missingness.value_dependent_intercept: 64 bisection iterations on[-20,20] using independent4096calibration rows; log achieved probability
missingness.outage: choose oneblock and startRU(0,117) on120-day positions; maskblock withprob0.95 for3selected days and0.02 otherwise; otherblocks unmasked
missingness.query_feature_contract: only decision-time features; investigation results and future outcomes never appended
missingness.mask_vs_verification: separate draws conditional on world variables; do not set missing cells from query labels

label_observation.complete_channel: all task fraud labels become known at day+H_mature
label_observation.incomplete_channel: no universal maturity; old/unreported rows mayremain unknown
label_observation.availability: earliest successful channel reveal time <= cutoff0
label_observation.observed_label_accuracy: correct when revealed in first version; misclassification is not silently added
label_observation.source_stratum_reveal_counts: binomial counts using union-of-independent-channel probability by day/trueclass/H; fraud-mode labels use same fraud reveal rule
label_observation.default_eligible_pool: all correctly revealed historical task targets bycutoff; retain sourceN_world separately
label_observation.reference_complete_regime: separate historical cohort with day+H_mature<=0, all outcomes adjudicated; reference counts use precisely thatcohort, not larger poolcontaining selectedfreshfeedback
label_observation.reference_incomplete_regime: unavailable bydefault; a past/external representativefullyadjudicatedreference may be supplied by separatelydeclared data, never fabricatedfrom selectivepool
learner_excludes: true selfreportpropensity unless independentlylogged in a separate audit

finance_shape.cell_cap_scope: per routed model context, not entire macroepisode; profile and charge allroutegroups
finance_shape.width_condition: conditionselectedstagewidths on actual boundedcontext+querychunk satisfyingcellcap; never silentlyremovefeatures orroutegroups

support_selector.reservoir_R: simple randomsample min(N_eligible,R_cap) withoutreplacement fromeligiblelabeledpool; sharedallroutes
support_selector.codec_fit_rows: R only, for modelinput and retrievalcodec in finance; not entireenrichedcontext
support_selector.codec: architecture numericmedian/MAD/rank andcategoricalfrequencydefinitions fitonR; reusefrozen transform forR/P/G/query
support_selector.event_pool_P: uniformwithoutreplacement min(M_eligible,P_cap) eligibleeventful IDs; allwhenbelowcap; sharedallroutes
support_selector.local_candidate_deployment: all eligibleverifiednegatives forbinary/multiclass/fraud-loss; all eligiblelabeledrows forfullamount
support_selector.index_coordinates: numeric2*support_midrank-1 andmissingflag; categoricalonehotincludingmissing, feature-specific identities; no generatorlatents
support_selector.index_projection: fixed seeded Rademacher signs +/-1/sqrt(128); divide by sqrt(feature_count); stable hash for categorical indicators

centers.positive_candidates: selected capped P only, not allobservedpositives
centers.positive_traversal: startlowestpersistentrandomID; repeatedly choosecandidatefarthestfromnearestalreadyselectedcenter; tiesstableID; stopat16 or allremainingdistanceszero
centers.remaining_traversal: same deterministicfarthest-first overR, measuringdistance toALLalreadyselectedcenters; ifnocenterexists startlowestR ID; stopat64 or no positive remainingdistance

support_selector.local_per_center: nearestmin(local_cap,|G|) candidateIDs tofixedcenter bysquaredEuclideanobservedindexdistance; stableIDties; streamchunks1024
support_selector.dedup_order: selectR/P/L independentlyunderdeclareddependencies, thenuniondedupIDs; do notexcludeRfromcandidate ranking
support_selector.context: R union P union L_center, onecopyperID andunionmembershipbits
support_selector.approximation: nearest-to-center support is not exactnearest-to-query support; fullcandidatecoverage doesnotremove64-routeapproximation

values_in_order: log1p(N_reference) when a complete reference exists; zero when unavailable or full_amount
metadata_adapter.zero_fraction_guard: whenpositive denominatorbutnumerator0 use finiteplaceholder0 and availablecountfields identifyzero; never log0

reference_conditions.kind0: no defensiblecomplete/adjudicatedreference; useoffset0, referencefeature0; do notcallneutral0.5anestimate

empty_eligible_history.codec: emptyfinite supportnumericcenter0 scale1 rank0.5; categoricalfrequency0/unseen1; ordinarymissingflagsretained
empty_eligible_history.scope: Finance populations with zero eligible history can emit empty support. Standard training still samples nonempty support, while the generic model and codec define this boundary for any supported task; it is not a finance-only model capability.

macroepisode_and_query_loss.evaluation_api: training=False defaults to natural_queries=True: unique finite future IDs without replacement, weight1, error if requested query_count exceeds finite future size. Explicit natural_queries=False is required to use proposal sampling with a full deployment index.

prediction_and_loss.binary_reference_parameterization: add log(1-pi_reference) tolegitimateclasslogit andlog(pi_reference) tofraudclasslogit; equivalentlogoddsresidual. Withunavailablereference addzerooffset.
prediction_and_loss.reference_log_numerics: stable log1p(-pi) andlog(pi) inFP32orwider; avoidrounding1-pi to1beforelog
prediction_and_loss.multiclass_reference_offset: Dirichlet(0.5 per declared class) posterior mean probabilities from complete historical cohort only, passed as reference_probs. Scalar event metadata uses separate Jeffreys(0.5,0.5) event frequency; these distinct shrinkage rules are declared, not identical.
prediction_and_loss.regression_loss: hurdle mixed-distribution NLL for fraud loss with exact zero atom, proposal weights, and positive log1p(loss) density Jacobian; full amount uses existing proper continuous-head NLL

entropy_normalization.apply_to: binary, multiclass, and realized-fraud-loss finance tasks with a complete historical event reference; full_amount multiplier1
